entries.name: Elixir
entries.author: Dan Majka
entries.description: Deep drum synth and sequencer that ports the Erica Synths LXR-02 and adds 22 more sound engines, generative sequencing, extensive randomization & modulation, live performance tricks, MIDI control of 300 parameters with Launchpad and Launch Control maps (see website), and 8-channel USB audio.

packages.notes: The LFOs' 5/16 and 3/16 are back. A track LFO's Sync has 5/16 and 3/16 again, in place of 1.5's 8/1 and 16/1. Kits and projects saved with 5/16 or 3/16 before 1.5 load with them as they were; anything saved in 1.5 with 8/1 or 16/1 loads as 4/1, the slowest sync. Projects, kits and settings from 1.5

Start new projects, a lighter load on the processor, mute and solo from the mixer, slower LFOs, and clearer hints on screen. Projects, kits and settings from 1.4 work as before. - New projects: LOAD -> PROJECT, an empty slot, OCT+ starts a fresh project there and saves it. - SAVE THEM FIRST? before

Steadier MIDI clock sync. With BPM set to MIDI, the tempo on the screen no longer jumps around above about 90 BPM: Elixir now measures the incoming clock over a whole beat instead of pulse by pulse. A synced delay and synced LFOs follow the steadier tempo too. Projects, kits and settings from 1.4 wo
- RELOAD from a MIDI controller: a button sending CC 19 on the remote's GLOBAL channel puts the kit and the playing pattern back as last saved (as hold OCT-, press key 13).

- Controller builder: send a template to any custom mode of a Launch Control XL 3 (1-15) or Launchpad Pro MK3 (1-8), no Components needed; a backup is optional. - New templates: mute and solo buttons toggle, white when off, red (mute) or green (solo) when on; effect buttons play while held. - CONFIG

- Keyboard folding: on KEYS, with a scale on the pattern, the white keys play the scale on any track; black keys 1-7 pick the track. - Volume and morph: track volumes no longer morph (like mutes and solos), so volume faders work at any morph amount.

- Held notes on the grid: a note longer than its step shows a thin bar on through the steps it holds, up to the next note. - Length in steps, as on the Elektrons: 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1 to 64, plus AUTO, INF and TIE; in the track's own steps whatever its clock. Older projects keep their lengths (a 1/8 rea

- Holding a step never changes it: a tap turns the step on or off as you let go; a held key keeps it, so you can hold a step, change pages and lock it without losing or adding a note. - CLEAR + turn a knob clears that knob's locks on the track: while recording at once (the steps the hold erased come

- Where you are: crumbs under the title on the sound and FX pages (SRC FLT SHP ENV MOD FX; REV BUS DLY DRT MST SND), the page number kept. - ENV, SCL and LFO always open their first page. - CONFIG > BUTTONS & KITS > Select BUTTON: SELECT stays on the button you pressed. - FX: ROUTING sits with the s

Pick morph kits with a knob, many more locks per step, a new dub SPRING reverb, WEAR controls for the whole kit, new global LFO moves, program changes out to your other gear, and a lighter engine that leaves room for more effects and heavy drum models at once. Projects from 1.3 load as before. Morph
- Fixed: switching the master filter away from RING no longer carries RING's Decay over as the other filters' Reso. RING's Decay is now its own setting, so LXR, ACID and MS20 keep theirs.

- Tap in a beat on the black keys. With REC on and the pattern playing, a track's black key records its hit, like a drum pad, so you can build a beat pass by pass and watch the steps appear on the grid. - Erasing while recording is clearer: hold OCT- and OCT+ together and the screen says ERASING AS

packages.notes: - **Saving while a pattern plays with THE VOICE on ALWAYS no longer locks the unit up.** The "SAVING" message was said again every millisecond it stayed up, so the speech took all the time and the save never finished. He says it once now. - **PRESETS with several steps held locks the sound on every

- **Projects keep their names again.** Since the five rooms came in, the unit could not read a project's header back (at power-on, at a project load): the project lost its name, and the settings kept there (the tracks' level, pan, sends, room sends and names) were not read from it either. The header

- **The manager edits sounds** ([the manager](https://quixotic7.github.io/evilgenius/manager/), Chrome or Edge over USB). RemoteFM1 picks up `evilgenius-0.1.1.rfm1` at its next nightly update. --- **Install it from the browser** (Chrome or Edge, USB): https://quixotic7

- **The first stable release.** The same firmware as 0.1.0-beta.4, now out of beta. - **EVILGENIUS in RemoteFM1.** Each release now carries `evilgenius-VERSION.rfm1`, and RemoteFM1 (the app, remotefm1.com and FM1VST) picks it up at its next nightly update. It plays in RemoteFM1's on-screen FM-1 in E

- **The mixer's knobs work as on the Home views**: PRESETS chooses the track and ALGORITHM the step (a knob turned with a step chosen locks it on that step). PRESETS no longer mutes; hold a track's black key to mute it. On the FX MIX page PRESETS is still TV's send. - **An LFO's MULT turns in the or

- **The start screen runs smoothly: 29 frames a second on the unit, from 11.** It drew more than the unit's frame holds, so the unit drew it the slow way, and its clock stepped 16 times a second: the picture stuttered and the line of text crawled four pixels a step. Now only the letters on screen ar

entries.name: ferrum
entries.author: MikeeTeevee
entries.description: The Interloper Ferrum is a firmware for the M-VAVE FM1 device. The software is an emulated tape looper. Choose from your box of cassettes, change the length and pitch of your loop. Play and dub sounds onto the loop and then shuttle it back and forth to create distorted and otherworldly sounds.

### What's new in 0.6.1 - **Less work with Reverb at 0:** once the reverb's tail has died away, the reverb stops running until you turn it up again (on the FM-1, about 24% → 15% CPU when nothing is playing). Nothing changes in the sound. **FiMba-1**: a physically modelled kalimba (thumb piano) firmw

### What's new in 0.5.0 - **Theme**, a new knob on the Setup page (GLO, KNOB 4): **Light**, the pale wood and dark ink as before, or **Dark**, near-black with cream and amber. entries.name: OberVave
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84, now on four tracks: each its own sound, arp and sequence; a mixer with chorus, delay, plate reverb and drive sends, a master with DJ filter and compressor. Tracks start on the bar, patterns keep their sounds.

packages.notes: - **Smooth pitch bend:** the bend now glides over a few milliseconds instead of jumping to each new value. A wheel only reports in steps (most MIDI keyboards send 128, the SMK-37's wheel about a hundred a side), and with a wider BEND range each one was an audible step; now it is one sweep. The glide

- **Locked to an external MIDI clock:** with a master that sends START and clock (SYNC AUTO), the sequencer, the tracks and the arp now stay on the master's beat for good. Before, the clock only set the tempo and the beat slowly slid away (up to half a second in five minutes). Each quarter is now ge

- **MASTER works again:** VOLUME, DJ FILTER, DRIVE and COMP on the mixer's MASTER row now change the sound as you turn them – before, they only took effect with the next pattern change. Reported by dmochen ([#19](https://github.com/zvenson/obervave/issues/19)) – thank you! - The browser simulator ha

- **Saving made simple: MEMORY.** SAVE opens one page with the 8 memory slots. A slot holds everything: the steps of all four tracks, their four sounds, the mixer, the effects and MASTER. KNOB 1 (or PRESETS) picks the slot, KNOB 2 (or SELECT) the action, SAVE does it: **SAVE**, **LOAD**, **COPY**, *

Press REC, then PLAY, and Polly records them with the velocity you playe

entries.description: A four-track groovebox: Plaits' 24 models, a 16-pad kit, a step sequencer with p-locks and trig conditions, nine generative sources you can PRINT into steps (Game of Life, chords, Tonnetz, orbits, bytebeat, an improviser...), live transposition, punch-in effects, four projects and a scene per page.

packages.notes: QUARTZ 0.10 for the M-VAVE FM-1. New: - PRINT: hold SEQ and press black key 5 twice while playing: the next loop a generative source plays is written into STEP steps, ready to edit by hand. - Live transposition: hold GLO and press a key: every synth track's steps play transposed so that the tonic so

QUARTZ 0.9 for the M-VAVE FM-1. New: - Four projects: hold SAVE and press black key 2-5 (twice) to load project 1-4; SAVE writes the one loaded; at power-on the FM-1 loads the project saved last. - Backup and restore over USB: the site's backup page, `tools/fm1_backup.py` and the emulator share one

In the online manual, a link to a section now lands on it: the pictures declare their size, so the page no longer moves while they load. The firmware is the same as 0.8 apart from its version: projects saved by 0.8 are kept.

The manual gets a page of its own for the sequencer, and a Pages block after its contents that lists every page: the sequencer, the nine families of models and the ten sources. Each page links back to it. The overview now counts nine generative sources. The firmware is the same as 0.8 apart from its

CIPHER, a new pattern source: bytebeat. At each step a formula of time gives a byte, and its bits decide whether the step plays, its accent and its note (or its pad on a kit). 32 formulas in four families, stepped with PRESET at their advised settings; A, B, C, DENS, LEN, START, SPEED and RANGE to s

When the six voices are busy, a new note now takes a released note first, then its own track's oldest (on a kit, another drum), and only then another track's held note: a kit's hits no longer cut the chords of LATTICE, MOONS or CADENCE. For developers: tools/device/probe.py reads the cores' load, lo

TAP TEMPO: hold GLO and tap black key 1 on the beat. From the second tap, TEMPO follows the mean gap of your last four taps (whole BPM, 40–240); a pause over 2 s starts the count again. While playing, only the speed changes. Install: https://f0nski.github.io/quartz/install/
